_readme: Drop a new option folder (with spec.json + model) inside its category folder, then add the folder name to that category's options list below. Nothing in index.html / main.css / main.js needs to change.

instructor.text: Welcome to the Energy Storage System Lab. We will load a real LiPo pack on the bench to find its safe current limits, then fly it to see how capacity trades off against endurance.
Start in Input Parameters — tap the Battery tile to open its option library. Pick a low-C undersized pack to explore the fault paths, or a high-C pack to see everything pass safely.

Module 1 · Pack Under Load puts the battery on the analyzer bench. C-Rating Safety Check ramps the full 4-motor draw and watches it against the pack's continuous rating; Voltage Sag Under Load traces loaded pack voltage down to a possible ESC brownout.

Module 2 · Energy & Endurance reuses the real assembled-drone hover flight sim: Endurance & Diminishing Returns flies the pack down to its cutoff and shows why a bigger battery brings sub-linear gains — and can even stop the drone from hovering at all.

SoC Discharge Mapping drains the pack on a discharge rig, tracing true coulomb-counted SoC against cell voltage and comparing it with a naive voltage-only estimate. An experiment only completes on a PASS — a fault run plays out fully but won't tick the progress bar.
Outstanding — every experiment is complete. Your reward component is now unlocked in the Outputs panel.
